definitions.gloss: approval request; request for authorization; internal proposal
definitions.explanation: A formal process in Japanese companies where a proposal document is circulated to relevant managers and executives for approval. Each approver stamps their seal (hanko) to indicate approval.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{稟議|りんぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
examples.english: Submit the new system implementation for approval.

examples.japanese: {稟議|りんぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}れば→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく。
examples.english: Once the approval request passes, we'll get the budget.

examples.japanese: ⟦{稟議書|りんぎしょ}→稟議書：26152_ringisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}して→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Create and submit the approval request document.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{稟|りん} (report to a superior) + {議|ぎ} (deliberation)

THE {稟議|りんぎ} SYSTEM:
A uniquely Japanese business practice where decisions are made through a bottom-up proposal system rather than top-down orders.

⟦{稟議書|りんぎしょ}→稟議書：26152_ringisho⟧ (ringi document) typically includes:
- ⟦{件名|けんめい}→件名：11552_kenmei⟧ - subject
- ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧ - purpose
- ⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧ - details
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧ - budget
- ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ - expected benefits
- {承認欄|しょうにんらん} - approval section (for stamps)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {稟議|りんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ - to circulate for approval
- {稟議|りんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ - to get approval
- {稟議|りんぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ - the proposal is approved
- {稟議|りんぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{却下|きゃっか}→却下：05908_kyakka⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ - the proposal is rejected

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {稟議|りんぎ} system reflects Japanese corporate culture's emphasis on consensus building (⟦{根回|ねまわ}し→根回し：07727_nemawashi⟧). Getting multiple stamps shows broad organizational support.
